name: City Council & Public Meeting Transcripts
tagline: Timestamped city council and county board meeting transcripts with agenda items and votes.
description: Give it a city or county meeting portal (Granicus, Swagit, Legistar) or a YouTube meeting video and get timestamped transcripts of council, county board and planning meetings. Optional extras: start and end times for each agenda item with video links, official votes from Legistar or the minutes, keyword alerts, a short verified meeting digest, and monitoring that returns only new meetings. Pricing: $0.008 per transcribed minute, $0.002 per meeting in list-only mode, $0.05 each for agenda timestamps or a digest. Meetings with no video or failed recordings are never charged.
